title: MuseBridge conversation-first Agent v2 contracts
description: Normative target contracts for agent-workflow-v2. Documentation only: the current runtime remains agent-run-v1. Use the named $defs at each boundary. JSON schema checks shape; language precedence, links, scope, provenance, completeness, state transitions and answer derivation require the accompanying runtime invariants. Decode strictly without duplicate keys, nonfinite values, coercion or integer-valued floats where integers are required. Draft revision 2 adds local clarification, canonical catalog facts, one-off content translation and visitor interpretation policies; it remains unimplemented.
